speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Good Friday morning! How are you today?

speaker: A8FZAMRMDKTU3
text: Morning. Just stating my day, good so far

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Same here. Waiting for coffee to kick in! I was surprised to wake up to such cold 56 degree weather. How is it by you?

speaker: A8FZAMRMDKTU3
text: Same here!  Looks good for today maybe some rain this weekend

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Yes, it looks like we are also slated for some rain, but if not we are hoping to swim and cookout for the holiday weekend. Do you have any plans?

speaker: A8FZAMRMDKTU3
text: In-laws are coming over. Wanted to go camping, but I don't think that's happening.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: We tried camping this summer, but got rained on! I am wondering, have you heard about the Save the Children charity?

speaker: A8FZAMRMDKTU3
text: Yes I have.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Oh good! Then you are familiar with them. I wanted to ask if you would be willing to donate any of today's pay to STC. Even $0.05 would help.

speaker: A8FZAMRMDKTU3
text: Do they have a website where I can go and read more about them?

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Yes, their website is  URL  Let me know if the link I sent comes through.

speaker: A8FZAMRMDKTU3
text: Yes it did. How do donate with you today?

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: You just have to tell me what amount you would like to donate from today's pay. If you want to give ten cents tell me $0.10.

speaker: A8FZAMRMDKTU3
text: Would you be ok taking .01$?

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Yes, that would be great. STC makes sure 90% of donations go directly to the kids. Did you see how much even a little can help?

speaker: A8FZAMRMDKTU3
text: I haven't been keeping up to date with them and still haven't read the website.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: STC helps kids not only in war torn countries, but also right here in the USA. Have you heard about the flooding in Hawaii?

speaker: A8FZAMRMDKTU3
text: I haven't yet but I know they had a hurricane.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Well, Save the Children has already pledged to help out. I want to confirm, you are donating $0.10, right? and thank you so much!
